title: Playing for Don Albert in San Antonio; a Barbarin record
summary: Joseph says Freddie's band worked in San Antonio for Don Albert, and they look at a Barbarin record without him.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Well, they have another drummer over there from here. Old fellow in San Antonio.
Did you see Don Albert, I guess?
Well, yeah, well, he stayed right around the corner from the house. We worked for him when we had Freddie band too.
You were over there? The whole Freddie Coleman band? Yeah. I didn't know they went over there.
Oh man, we went, we went, quite a few places. We had a pretty nice little band. Not to say our band was at the Mardi Grimes.
